title: Hogwarts Legacy Costs You 22¢ an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Hogwarts Legacy is $5.99 on Steam this week (90% off $59.99) and the main story takes about 27 hours (HowLongToBeat): 22¢ an hour. Full price is $2.22 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Our own math.
Which game should we price next?

Sources: Steam store (US price, 26 Nov), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: Send this to the friend with 300 hours in Hogwarts Legacy: it's $5.99 this week, 22¢ an hour.
